ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Annapurna Swadisht Limited's Promoter and Managing Director, Mr. Ritesh Shaw, has released a pledge on 650,000 equity shares, representing 2.80% of the company's total share capital. This positive development reduces the proportion of his total pledged holdings from 28.02% to 25.05%, indicating a decrease in financial leverage risk for the promoter and mitigating potential future selling pressure on the stock. No red flags are identified in this disclosure; it signifies an improvement in the promoter's financial position.
